title: calendar files
description: One schema for all three kinds of calendar file. Monthly files (YYYY-MM.yml) are lists of dated entries. recurring.yml holds the weekly rhythm and the holiday list. evergreen.yml is a list of date-less backup posts. The validator picks the right definition below based on the file name; the top-level anyOf is documentation of the union only (anyOf, not oneOf, because an empty list legitimately matches both list-shaped branches).
$comment: Design note: dated entries and evergreen entries are separate definitions rather than one shape with optional fields, because their rules genuinely differ - dated entries have an id that must start with the date, while evergreen entries have a 'slug' and MUST NOT have a date (the real id is built as date+slug on the day the entry is used).

isoDate.$comment: Shape only (YYYY-MM-DD). The validator additionally checks the date really exists on the calendar.

ctaKey.$comment: Must exist as a key in brand/ctas.yml - the validator cross-checks this.

image.$comment: template:<name> uses an SVG template from assets/templates, asset:<path> uses a fixed file, none means no image.

status.$comment: Machine-updated. Hand-written entries can omit it; the system treats a missing status as 'planned'.

datedEntry.$comment: research (default false), image (default none) and status (default planned) may be omitted; angle and source are optional by design.

id.$comment: Globally unique, THE dedup key. Must start with the entry's date - the validator cross-checks this.

slot.$comment: Must exist under 'slots:' in config/settings.yml - the validator cross-checks this.

source.$comment: Optional pointer to existing Servio content, e.g. blog:page-speed-revenue.

evergreenEntry.$comment: No 'date' and no 'id' here on purpose: evergreen posts are date-less. The system builds the full id (date + slug) on the day the entry is consumed and flips 'used' to true.

weeklyDay.$comment: The default plan for one day of the week, used only when no dated entry or holiday exists for that date.
